verses.geez:
አመ፡ ፳ወ፯ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለኢዮርብዓም፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ [ነግሠ፡ አዛርያስ፡ ወልደ፡ አሜስያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ
።]
verses.translation: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel Azarias the son of Amessias king of Juda began to reign.

verses.geez:
ወ፲ወ፮ክረምቱ፡ ለአዛርያስ፡ አመ፡ ይነግሥ ፤ ፶ወ፪ክረምተ፡ ነግሠ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወስማ፡ ለእሙ፡ ከልያ፡ እንተ፡
            ኢየሩሳሌም።
verses.translation: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jechelia of Jerusalem.

verses.geez: ወገብረ፡ ጽድቀ፡ በቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘከመ፡ ገብረ፡ አሜስያስ፡ አቡሁ።
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, according to all things that Amessias his father did.

verses.geez: ወአብያተ፡ አማልክትሰ፡ ኢያሰሰለ ፤ ዓዲሆሙ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ህየ፡ የዐጥኑ፡ ወይሠውዑ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያተ፡ አማልክት።
verses.translation: Only he took not away any of the high places: as yet the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places.

verses.geez: ወገሰሶ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለንጉሥ፡ ወአኀዞ፡ ለምጽ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ሞተ፡ ወነግሠ፡ እምቤተ፡ አፍሶት፡ ወዮናታን፡ ወልደ፡ ንጉሥ፡ የዐቅብ፡ ቤቶ፡ ወይኴንን፡ አሕዛበ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And the Lord plagued the king, and he was leprous till the day of his death; and he reigned in a separate house. And Joatham the king's son was over the household, judging the people of the land.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለአዛርያስ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡
            ይሁዳ።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Azarias, and all that he did, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

verses.geez: ወስከበ፡ አዛርያስ፡ ምሰለ፡ አበዊሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ሀገረ፡ ዳዊት፡ ወነግሠ፡ ዮናታን፡ ወልዱ፡ ህየንቴሁ።
verses.translation: And Azarias slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Joatham his son reigned in his stead.

verses.geez:
ወአመ፡ ፴ወ፰ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለአዛርያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ነግሠ፡ አዜኬርያስ፡ ወልደ፡ ኢዮርብዓም፡ ለእስራኤል፡
            በሰማርያ፡ ፮አውራኀ።
verses.translation: In the thirty and eighth year of Azarias king of Juda Zacharias the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ፡ እኩየ፡ ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በከመ፡ ገብሩ፡ አበዊሁ፡ ወኢኀደገ፡ ኀጢአቶ፡ ለኢዮርብዓም፡
            ወልደ፡ ናባጥ፡ ዘአስሐቶሙ፡ ለእስራኤል።
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his fathers had done: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.geez: ወዐለውዎ፡ ሴሎም፡ ወልደ፡ ኢያቢሶ፡ ወበላዓን፡ ወሴሎም፡ አቡሁ፡ ቀተልዎ፡ ወነግሠ፡ ሴሎም፡ ህየንቴሁ።
verses.translation: And Sellum the son of Jabis and others conspired against him, and they smote him in Keblaam, and slew him, and he reigned in his stead.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለአዜኬርያስ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Zacharias, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.geez:
ወዝውእቱ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለኢዩ፡ ዘይቤለመ፡ እስከ፡ ራብዕ፡ ትውልድከ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስተ፡ መንበረ፡ እስራኤል፡
            ወከማሁ፡ ኮነ።
verses.translation: This was the word of the Lord which he spoke to Ju, saying, Thy sons of the fourth generation shall sit upon the throne of Israel: and it was so.

verses.geez: ወነግሠ፡ ሴሎም፡ ወልደ፡ ያቤሳ ፤ አመ፡ ፴ወ፱ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለአዛርያ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ነግሠ፡ ሴሎም፡ ፴መዋዕለ፡ በሰማርያ።
verses.translation: And Sellum the son of Jabis reigned: and in the thirty and ninth year of Azarias king of Juda began Sellum to reign a full month in Samaria.

verses.geez: ወዐርገ፡ ምናሔም፡ ወልደ፡ ጌዱ፡ እምተርሲላቅ፡ ወሖረ፡ ሰማርያ፡ ወቀተሎ፡ ለሴሎም፡ ወልደ፡ ያቤሶ፡ በሰማርያ።
verses.translation: And Manaem the son of Gaddi went up out of Tharsila, and came to Samaria, and smote Sellum the son of Jabis in Samaria, and slew him.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለሴሎም፡ ወማዕሌቱኒ፡ ዘዐለወ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ፡
            ለነገሥተ፡ እስራኤል።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Sellum, and his conspiracy wherein he was engaged, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ፡ ቀተሎሙ፡ ምናሔም፡ ለቴርሳ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ቴርሳ፡ ወለኵሉ፡ አድያሚሆሙ፡ ወዘእምቴርሳ፡ እስመ፡
            [ኢያ]ርኀውዎ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ወፅኑሳቲሆሙኒ፡ ነፀሮን።
verses.translation: Then Manaem smote both Thersa and all that was in it, and its borders extending beyond Thersa, because they opened not to him: and he smote it, and ripped up the women with child.

verses.geez:
ወአመ፡ ፴ወ፱ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለአዛርያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ነግሠ፡ ምናሔም፡ ወልደ፡ ጊዱ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ ፲ክረምተ፡
            በሰማርያ።
verses.translation: In the thirty and ninth year of Azarias king of Juda began Manaem the son of Gaddi to reign over Israel in Samaria ten years.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ፡ እኩየ፡ ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢኀደገ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኀጢአቶ፡ ለኢዮርብዓም፡ ወልደ፡ ናባጥ፡
            ዘአስሐቶሙ፡ ለእስራኤል።
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin.

verses.geez:
ወበመዋዕሊሁ፡ ዐርገ፡ ፎሐ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ውስተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ብሔር፡ ወወሀቦ፡ ምናሔም፡ ለፉሐ፡ ፲፻መካልየ፡ ብሩር፡
            ከመ፡ ይኅበር፡ ምስሌሁ።
verses.translation: In his days went up Phua king of the Assyrians against the land: and Manaem gave to Phua a thousand talents of silver to aid him with his power.

verses.geez:
ወአዘዞሙ፡ ምናሔም፡ ለእስራኤል፡ የሀብዎ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ብሩረ፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ያስተዋፅኡ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ብእሲ፡
            በበ፶ሰቅሎን፡ ወኢቦአ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ወኢነበረ፡ ውስተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ብሔር።
verses.translation: And Manaem raised the silver by a tax upon Israel, even on every mighty man in wealth, to give to the king of the Assyrians, fifty shekels levied on each man; and the king of the Assyrians departed, and remained not there in the land.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለምናሔም፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡
            እስራኤል።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Manaem, and all that he did, behold, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.geez: ወሰከበ፡ ምናሔም፡ ምስለ፡ አበዊሁ።
verses.translation: And Manaem slept with his fathers; and Phakesias his son reigned in his stead.

verses.geez:
ወአመ፡ ኀምሳ፡ ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለአዛርያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ነግሠ፡ ፋቄስያስ፡ ወልደ፡ ምናሔም፡ ለእስራኤል፡
            በሰማርያ፡ ፪ዓመተ።
verses.translation: In the fiftieth year of Azarias king of Juda, began Phakesias the son of Manaem to reign over Israel in Samaria two years.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ፡ እኩየ፡ ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢኀደገ፡ ኀጢአቶ፡ ለኢዮርብዓም፡ ወልደ፡ ናባጥ፡ ዘአስሐቶሙ፡
            ለእስራኤል።
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.geez: ወዐለዎ፡ ፋቂሔ፡ ወልደ፡ ሮሜልዩ፡ ወዓሊሁ፡ ወቀተስመ፡ በሰማርያ፡ በቅድመ፡ ቤተ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ምስለ፡ አርጎብ፡ ወምስለ፡ አርያ፡ ወምስሌሁ፡ ፶ብእሲ፡ እምውስተ፡ ፬፻ወቀተሎ፡ ወነግሠ፡ ህየንቴሁ።
verses.translation: And Phakee the son of Romelias, his officer, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria in the front of the king's house, with Argob and Aria, and with him there were fifty men of the four hundred: and he slew him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለፋቄስያስ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡
            እስራኤል።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Phakesias, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.geez:
ወአመ፡ ፶ወ፪ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለአዛርያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ፡ ነግሠ፡ ፋቁሔ፡ ወልደ፡ ሮሜልዩ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ በሰማርያ፡
            ፳ክረምተ።
verses.translation: In the fifty-second year of Azarias king of Juda began Phakee the son of Romelias to reign over Israel in Samaria twenty years.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ፡ እኩየ፡ ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወኢኀደገ፡ ኀጢአቶ፡ ለኢዮርብዓም፡ ወልደ፡ ናባጥ፡ ዘአስሐቶሙ፡
            ለእስራኤል።
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who led Israel to sin.

verses.geez:
በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ለፋቁሔ፡ መጽአ፡ ተልገተፌለሰር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ፋርስ፡ ወነሥኦ፡ ለናይን፡ ወለአቤል፡ ወለዘምሕኮ፡ ወለዘአንዮኅ፡
            ወለቄኔዝ፡ ወለአሶር፡ ወለገለአድ፡ እንተ፡ ገሊላ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ምድረ፡ ንፍታሌም፡ ወአፍለሶሙ፡ ብሔረ፡ ፋርስ።
verses.translation: In the days of Phakee king of Israel came Thalgath-phellasar king of the Assyrians, and took Ain, and Abel, and Thamaacha, and Anioch, and Kenez, and Asor, and Galaa, and Galilee, even all the land of Nephthali, and carried them away to the Assyrians.

verses.geez:
ወዐለዎ፡ ማዕሌተ፡ ሆሴዕ፡ ወልደ፡ ኤላ፡ ለፋቁሔ፡ ወልደ፡ ሮሜልዩ፡ ወቀተሎ፡ ወነግሠ፡ ህየንቴሁ፡ አመ፡ ፳ዓመቱ፡
            ለዮናታን፡ ወልደ፡ አዛርያስ።
verses.translation: And Osee son of Ela formed a conspiracy against Phakee the son of Romelias, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Joatham the son of Azarias.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለፋቁሔ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነቢያቲሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡
            እስራኤል።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Phakee, and all that he did, behold, these are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.geez: አመ፡ ፪ዓመተ፡ መንግሥቱ፡ ለፋቁሔ፡ ወልደ፡ ሮሜልዩ፡ ንጉሠ፡ እስራኤል፡ ነግሠ፡ ዮአታም፡ ወልደ፡ አዘርያስ፡ ንጉሠ፡ ይሁዳ።
verses.translation: In the second year of Phakee son of Romelias king of Israel began Joatham the son of Azarias king of Juda to reign.

verses.geez: እንዘ፡ ፳ወ፭ክረምቱ፡ አመ፡ ይነግሥ ፤ ወ፲ወ፮ክረምተ፡ ነግሁ፡ በኢየሩሳሌም፡ ወስማ፡ ለእሙ፡ ዔሩሳ፡ ወለተ፡ ሳዱቅ።
verses.translation: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Jerusa daughter of Sadoc.

verses.geez: ወገብረ፡ ሠናየ፡ ቅድመ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘከመ፡ ገብረ፡ አዛርያስ፡ አቡሁ።
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all things that his father Azarias did.

verses.geez:
ወባሕቱ፡ ቤተ፡ አማልክት፡ ኢያሰሰለ፡ ወዓዲሆሙ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ይሠውዑ፡ ወየዐጥኑ፡ ውስተ፡ አብያተ፡ አማልክት፡ ወውእቱ፡
            ሐነጸ፡ አንቀጸ፡ ቤተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ላዕሌየ።
verses.translation: Nevertheless he took not away the high places: as yet the people sacrificed and burnt incense on the high places. He built the upper gate of the Lord's house.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ፡ ነገሩ፡ ለዮአታም፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ናሁ፡ ዝውእቱ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ነዚያቲሆሙ፡ ለነገሥተ፡ ይሁዳ
።
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Joatham, and all that he did, are not these written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Juda?

verses.geez:
ወይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ አኀዘ፡ ይፈንዎ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለረዐሶን፡ ንጉሠ፡ ሶርያ፡ ወፋቁሔ፡ ወልደ፡ ሮሜልዩ፡ ውስተ፡
            ኢየሩሳሌም።
verses.translation: In those days the Lord began to send forth against Juda Raasson king of Syria, and Phakee son of Romelias.

verses.geez: ወሰከበ፡ ኢዮአታም፡ ምስለ፡ አበዊሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ሀገረ፡ ዳዊት፡ አቡሁ፡ ወነግሠ፡ አካዝ፡ ወልዱ፡ ህየንቴሁ።
verses.translation: And Joatham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Achaz his son reigned in his stead.
